'''Skeletons''' in Daemonheim can only be found in the Abandoned, Occult, and Warped floors. Attacks by throwing skulls at players, and frequently changes targets. They are weak to crush attacks. These skeletons have a tannish colour, and their attack has a distinctive sound.
